value.rationale: The complete nodal geometry of a positive, zero-free Fourier-multiplier Gaussian heat mixture is an intrinsic motivated invariant for Laplacian-of-Gaussian zero-crossing filters. The result classifies all dimensions, scale ratios and weights with sharp equality multiplicities, and gives a nontrivial dimension-dependent bifurcation threshold and explicit 3/2-power cusp. The surprising coexistence of strict radial unimodality with three nodal spheres gives structural information rather than a routine one-case computation.
